rows.grounds: compound of homa (oblation) and ādikaṃ (and the like), accusative object

items.question: Why are homa and related rites fruitless without maiden worship?
premises: Homa and related rites are fruitless.
Maiden worship is required for fruit.
items.inference: Therefore homa alone lacks efficacy; maiden worship is indispensable.
uncertainties: Whether viphalaṃ modifies homādikaṃ or the whole clause; the final token keeps the prepositional phrase fused.
items.plain_english: Oblations and the like are indeed fruitless without maiden worship.
